## Dieses Dokument

- Titel: Brieffragment von Lotte Zweig an Hannah; Altmann, Manfred Altmann [Oktober 1941], SZ-AAL/B1.170
- Signatur: SZ-AAL/B1.170
- Datum: 10.1941
- Objekttyp: Brieffragment
- Umfang: 3 Scans

pages.transcription:
From Wilmot I had direct infomation. As far all is in order, let us hope the same
for the future.
About the business and financial arrangements you had to make for us with
Wilmot etc. I suppose Stein will write you himself. I feel sure that you
have done everything at lest as well as we could have done it ourselves,
and I am afraid you spent as much time and thought on it than Stefan would
have done. Many, many thanks! Thori wrote us a letter some time ago, that
he is not allowed to have any relations with people in Hungary and that the
money the Hungarian publisher has or had in England is blocked, so that no
payment may be expected. Ax - Now I have written more than my share and must
leave the rest of the page to Stefan. Please send the two first sheets of
this letter on to mother so that I need not repeat myself.

Dear H. & R. we like our stay here very much. It is life like our
parents and grandfathers had and the people are so extremely nice and
ever clean in their great poverty. Food is still not artificial, the baker
bakes his bread and his excellent cakes himself and our life-expenses
are one third as those in America. Others would call Petropolis out of
reason a frightfully dull place but for somebody like me who wants
no other thing than to work and to read quietly, to enjoy walks in the
beautiful surroundings. it is the perfect thing I cant imagine the variety of types and chara-
teristic topics in the Brazilian life, I enjoy it enormously after the
monotony of American streets. Dear Hannah, you will understand that
one gets more and more sceptic against a civilization & seeing the gloss
results of it and that this peaceful, more primitive, more natural life
has a quite new attraction; the only weak point are books but I have
bought a Shakespeare, a Goethe, a Homer and with this and some other
which I can lend from others one can live for a certain time especially
if one writes his own ones. What I miss are reference-books when I
need some details and in urgent cases I have to wait 4-6 weeks to
get information from Newyork. As to the material things I feel much
more free and careless than there; I have certain things and fears which
worried me very much and which I cannot explain to you as they
are too complicated but I repeat that from here all looks much
more indifferent and we become more and more able to forget the
possibilities of the future. This war takes such proportions that all
positions and all fears are futile, every thought of a post war life
and consequences of former mistakes is wasted. I do quietly my
work and hope to be through my autobiography in a few weeks
having completed still in Ossining the record draft - Lottes health
is somewhat improved and so we have not to complain; I wish you

[Randnotiz links, von unten nach oben geschrieben:]
could see our little bungalow in the mountains
Elegante (in reality a tiny room but nicknamed open café, in which I am nearly the only
white man and Lotte the sensation as never another white lady would enter
such a popular place) Perhaps we shall even get a dog! knows Stefan
pages.notes: Handschriftlicher Brief auf einem Blatt, beidseitig beschrieben. Die Randnotiz links ist vertikal geschrieben. Die Tinte ist violett.
Rückseite des Dokuments, zeigt den durchscheinenden Text der Vorderseite (spiegelverkehrt). Keine eigene Beschriftung.
Farbskala/Grauskala fuer Archivierung. Überlagert den Text der Vorderseite.
